name: adapt_moved_package_java_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the package the agent's first solution imports is MOVED between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, old package deleted, new one created); the agent must update its import, not keep pointing at the old package
prompts: com/optarena/pricing/Rules.java (package com.optarena.pricing) declares a public static final double DISCOUNT. Create com/optarena/checkout/Checkout.java (package com.optarena.checkout) with a public static double applyDiscount(double price) that returns price * (1 - Rules.DISCOUNT), importing com.optarena.pricing.Rules.

com/optarena/pricing/Rules.java has moved to com/optarena/config/Rules.java (package com.optarena.config, same DISCOUNT value). Update Checkout.java's import to use com.optarena.config.Rules - do not keep importing the old pricing package.
